<script type="application/shiny-prerendered" data-context="server-extras">
ojs_define <- function(..., .session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()) {
  quos <- rlang::enquos(...)
  vars <- rlang::list2(...)
  nm <- names(vars)
  if (is.null(nm)) {
    nm <- rep_len("", length(vars))
  }
  mapply(function(q, nm, val) {
    # Infer name, if possible
    if (nm == "") {
      tryCatch({
        nm <- rlang::as_name(q)
      }, error = function(e) {
        code <- paste(collapse = "\n", deparse(rlang::f_rhs(q)))
        stop("ojs_define() could not create a name for the argument: ", code)
      })
    }
    .session$output[[nm]] <- val
    outputOptions(.session$output, nm, suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
    .session$sendCustomMessage("ojs-export", list(name = nm))
    NULL
  }, quos, nm, vars, SIMPLIFY = FALSE, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  invisible()
}
</script>

<script type="application/shiny-prerendered" data-context="server">
penguins_data <- read_csv("penguins.csv" )
penguins <- na.omit(penguins_data)

output$penguinsOutputId <- renderTable(
  {
    penguins %>% 
      head()
  }, caption = "Présentation des données"
)

output$univariateOutputId <- renderTable({
  variable = input$variableInputId
    penguins %>%
      group_by(species) %>%
      summarise(
        min = min(!!rlang::sym(variable)),
        max = max(!!rlang::sym(variable)),
        mean = mean(!!rlang::sym(variable)),
        var = var(!!rlang::sym(variable)),
        sd = sd(!!rlang::sym(variable)),
        median = median(!!rlang::sym(variable))
    )
  }, caption = "Analyse statistique des Variables"
)

output$species_island_countOutputId <- renderTable({
  species_island_count <- penguins %>%
    group_by(species, island) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
}, caption = "Nombre de pingouins par espèce et par île"
) 

output$species_island_countplotOutputId <- renderPlotly({
  (species_island_count <- penguins %>%
    group_by(species, island) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = island, y = count, fill = species)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = "Répartition des espèces de pingouins par île", x = "Île", y = "Nombre de pingouins")
   
})


output$penguinsboxplotOutputId <- renderPlotly({
  penguins %>%
    ggplot( mapping = aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = "Longueur du bec par espèce", x = "Espèce", y = "Longueur du bec (mm)")

})

output$ScatterplotOutputId <- renderPlotly({
  variable1 = input$variableInputId1
  variable2 = input$variableInputId2
  penguins %>%
    ggplot(mapping =  aes(x = !!rlang::sym(variable1), y = !!rlang::sym(variable2), color = species)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = "Relation entre la longueur du bec, profondeur du bec et la masse corporelle ", x = paste(variable1), y = paste(variable2))

})

output$densityplotOutputId <- renderPlotly({
  variable3 = input$variableInputId3
  penguins %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = !!rlang::sym(variable3))) +
    geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Density of variables", x = paste(variable3), y = "Densité")
})

output$sexplotOutputId <- renderPlotly({
  penguins %>%
    ggplot(mapping =  aes(x = sex, fill = species)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = "Comparaison des sexes des pingouins par espèce", x = "Sexe", y = "Nombre de pingouins")
})

output$regressionplotOutputId <- renderPlotly({
  penguins %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
    labs(title = "Relation entre la longueur de la nageoire et le poids corporel", x = "Longueur de la nageoire (mm)", y = "Poids corporel (g)")

})







</script>
